_format: Owned by pipeline_runner.py (app v2). Read at the start of every run, so it can be tuned without restarting the server.

stages.<render|detect|lift>: 'script' (path relative to open_vocab_3d/, run with the runner's interpreter: python -u script) or 'cmd' (full argv prefix; '{python}' = the runner's interpreter), plus 'args'.
args are mapped to CLI flags: true -> '--flag'; false/null -> omitted; list -> '--flag=a,b'; anything else -> '--flag=value'. Keys starting with '_' are ignored.
stages.*.args are shared by both passes. pass1.render_args / pass1.lift_args and two_pass.render_args / two_pass.lift_args are merged on top (a null value removes a shared flag).

The runner injects the I/O flags itself: render --usd/--out (and --focus-domes in pass 2), detect --renders/--out/--prompts, lift --renders/--detections/--out; lift '--save-ply': true becomes <run dir>/<pass>/clusters.ply.

two_pass: the pass-1 lift objects whose class is in anchor_classes give the focus centres (box centres, confidence-weighted when merged). With no anchor, fallback: any object whose larger horizontal box side is >= fallback_min_extent_m. Centres closer than merge_distance_m are merged; at most max_focus are kept (most supporting views first). Each focus centre becomes one --focus-domes entry 'x,y,z,focus_radius_m,focus_num_views'. With no centre, pass 2 is skipped and the final lift runs on pass 1 alone. enabled=false always skips pass 2.
prompts: the UI default prompt list.
_notes: Two-pass layout (2026-10-07) replaces the scene-specific focus dome below with automatic focus centres from pass-1 anchors; all other values are the R&D retune. R&D retune 2026-10-07 for scenes/room_scan_upright.usda (13 classes), validated by projecting the 3D boxes onto renders. RENDER: the wide dome (30 views, radius-scale 0.4) frames the whole scan (booth, window wall, floor), but the table items are too small in it: phone ~30 px, light switch ~18 px. --focus-domes (new) adds 30 views on a 2.0 m dome around the booth table (1.15,-0.5,-1.4), which brings the phone to ~80 px, the light switch to ~50 px and the headphones to ~170 px. A 1.5 m focus dome loses the wall plates. Interior views (eye height, any pitch set) see the table items in only 0-3 frames, and 'both' adds no coverage that the focus dome lacks. DETECT: one 13-phrase caption leaves headphones, phone and light switch at 0 detections, and ~100+ boxes come back with empty phrases. --prompt-group-size 2 (new) runs 7 short captions per frame; headphones, phone, light switch and all 3 plates appear, at ~3.4 s/frame instead of ~1.2 s. Group size 1 is ~6 s/frame with no better 3D result. Group size 5 zeroes small classes again, because results depend on which phrases share a caption. A box threshold of 0.2 is filtered in lift; text threshold 0.3 gave identical 3D results. LIFT: --min-score 0.3. The per-class size limits come from measured true sizes (table 1.1, bench 1.0, cushion 0.3, laptop 0.42, backpack 0.47, headphones 0.3, phone 0.15, plate 0.25-0.4, light switch 0.08 m), with margin, below the size of whole-booth or whole-seating-area boxes (1.6-2 m). Detection-centroid clustering separates small touching or neighbouring objects (plates, phones, headphones, switch, cushions). --cross-class-nms 0.3 resolves phone vs 'hanging plant' and similar double labels. --min-views 5, with table/bench 10 and phone 6: true large objects have 22-60 supporting views, while the false positives (a bench labelled table, the mouse labelled phone, the crumpled bag labelled cushion) have 3-7. KNOWN: no cabinet. The 'hanging plant' hits are mostly the plant-picture plates; a dark ceiling fragment at (3.2,1.5,-0.5) is sometimes boxed as a hanging plant and can't be verified. The window box includes the white wall below it (~2.1 m tall). Only 1 of the 2 turf panels is found, and results shift with the dome seed.
